wire.title: Infra health: 3 critical finding(s)
wire.body:
**Infra health check — CRITICAL**

- Cloudflare API token INVALID — `/user/tokens/verify` status=unknown (HTTP 401). TF applies will 401.
- TLS cert for **niflheim** (`netbox.niflheim.xiiisins.com`) expires in 2d (<3d) — renewal stuck?
- Vault AppRole `ansible-frigg` SecretID expires in 9 day(s) (2026-10-10) — rotate via docs/procedures/credential-rotation.md.
